name: Band Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with a band looped around both feet, knees over hips, and fingertips behind your ears.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor and brace your abs firmly.
Extend your right leg as you turn your right shoulder toward your bent left knee.
Return smoothly through center and repeat on the other side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Rotate through your rib cage rather than pulling your head forward with your hands.
Keep the band looped around your midfoot arches so it cannot slip off your toes.
